statements.impact_statement: CVE-2026-116587 is a denial of service from crafted RSA parameters in a parsed JWK in go-jose v3 (no v3 fix; fixed in v4 4.1.6). In spire the only importer of v3 is github.com/spiffe/spire-plugin-sdk/pluginsdk/support/bundleformat, used by the server's bundlepublisher plugins (k8s ConfigMap, S3, GCS, Azure Blob, AWS Roles Anywhere). Its toJWKS (bundleformat.go:130-152) builds a jose.JSONWebKeySet from the server's own X.509 and JWT authorities and json.Marshal-s it: it never parses a JWK, decrypts a JWE or parses a JOSE object, which is where the flaw lives. The recipe fails the build if any package other than bundleformat imports v3 (go list -deps over cmd/spire-server and cmd/spire-agent). Checked 2026-11-11 against spire 1.16.0 and spire-plugin-sdk e961422db712.
